about.statement: I care about systems that are simple to run, cheap to operate, and hard to break.
about.p1: I build backend services and the infrastructure around them — APIs, background jobs, databases, and deploys. I like the unglamorous parts: clear logs, health checks, sensible defaults, and automation that removes 2 a.m. pages.
about.p2: Outside of work I write about cloud cost, self-host side projects on Oracle's free tier, and tinker with containers.
